Finish this sentence: "The Lord is always working everything out for my good, not because I'm perfect, but because I am..."

This is the mindset of the Kingdom person: we don't have to be flawless to experience God's favor. We just have to trust in His power and goodness. What is your story of overcoming imperfection and experiencing God's blessing? Share with us in the comments below.
